statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The patient reports intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
The patient's symptoms are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitoring study) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The service is clinically indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias
The monitoring is necessary to identify the underlying cause of the patient's symptoms
Standard ECG alone cannot adequately assess the patient's condition
